summary: 'Nice to meet you' is NICE flowing into MEET, usually with a nod toward the person. Two signs, one motion.
steps: Sign NICE: slide your flat dominant hand across your flat non-dominant palm.
Flow straight into MEET: two upright index fingers coming together.
Add a small nod and a warm face. Many signers also add a point to YOU at the end.
mistakes: Pausing between NICE and MEET. Sign it as one phrase.
Signing it with a flat expression. A warm face is part of the sign.

faq.q: Do I need to sign YOU at the end?
faq.a: It's optional. NICE MEET with eye contact already means 'nice to meet you.' Adding a point to the person is common and a little more complete.
